findings: Retained 23 new question wordings over 15 information needs: 15 assistant-authored and eight local 30B wordings with source-reviewed references. These span four additional AMI meetings and two earnings calls. They are simulated requests, not original human dialogue.

Short questions can be useful without forcing a multi-part summary: “What was that tool for transforming the XML?” and “Did we ever settle on the company colour?” ask for facts that earlier discussion supplies. Requester motivation and the actual cutoff are checked separately from fluency.

The 30B reader is a useful diagnostic, but cannot certify its own labels: it still swaps a nearby 34% learning-difficulty statistic for the actual 50% remote-loss figure and fails earlier capacity/ownership questions. Thirty-three question-only calls cite nonexistent context. Manual source review remains necessary.
Two real document lookups run through a local search/open backend. They establish source pages and availability gates, not an autonomous model tool policy. No new audio or answer TTS is generated.
span_findings: The first evidence-first attempt was cancelled after 29 recorded calls because constrained decoding repeatedly emitted whitespace; nine partial calls hit the cap. Its original artifacts are preserved. This attempt is included in allocation cost.

A bounded retry disabled arbitrary grammar whitespace and clarified that the new request need not already appear in the transcript. All four probes parsed, but three abstained despite source evidence and one altered source capitalisation in its copied quote. It failed the exact-span qualification; the broader 82-call follow-up did not run.

The failure is not a reason to accept the original reader unchecked. A separate CPU-tested empty-context guard returns missing context without inference; exact quote checks and direct source review remain distinct checks.
curation_scope: Offline source selection can inspect whole transcript files. Model generation/readers receive only the chosen past prefix, and retained factual references must be supported there. No future-unseen curator or request-anticipation result is claimed.
